title: Stuck - a backrooms mod
description: Get lost in the Backrooms. Yellow hallways, battery flashlight, exploration map, and a hidden Async Research terminal. Inspired by Kane Pixels.
body:
🟡 Stuck_ a backrooms mod
Get lost in the noclipped reality.

⚠️ Important — Read Me First
This is my first Minecraft mod. I'm learning as I build, so expect bugs, weird behavior, and rough edges — especially during this alpha phase.

If you find an issue, please be patient and report it so I can fix it. Thanks for trying it out and supporting a beginner modder! 🙏

🟡 How to Play — IMPORTANT
When you create a new world with this mod installed, you will spawn DIRECTLY in the Backrooms — not in the Overworld.

This is intentional! The mod is designed around the feeling of waking up already lost in the noclipped reality.

If you want to leave the Backrooms, two ways are now possible:
🚪 Find the legendary Exit Room — an extremely rare structure (1 in 5000 chunks) containing the iconic red Exit Door. You'll need an Exit Key (found in crates) to unlock it.
🛠️ Use the /backrooms command — debug shortcut that teleports you between dimensions.

If you die inside the Backrooms, you'll respawn inside the Backrooms (not the Overworld). The dimension remembers you.

🎮 Alpha State — What to Expect
This mod is in early alpha. Some important things to know before playing:

🎒 Most blocks and items still do NOT spawn naturally — they are available through the Creative inventory (Backrooms tab). Some items have started appearing in world loot (see below).
🚫 You cannot gather raw resources in the Backrooms. No ores, no trees, no animals. The dimension is a resource dead-end — by design.
🔋 Hunger is replaced by an Energy system. Manage your stamina by drinking Almond Water and being careful with sprint/jump/attack.
💡 Recommended: Play in Creative mode during alpha for the best experience. Survival is now viable for short runs but still harsh.
🌐 If you want survival resources, use /backrooms to teleport to the Overworld and gather materials there.

🟡 About
Stuck_ a backrooms mod is a Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 mod that adds a procedurally generated Backrooms dimension inspired by the iconic Kane Pixels YouTube series. Explore endless yellow hallways, manage your energy, uncover classified Async Research lore, find the exit door, and try to survive the liminal nightmare.

✨ Main Features

🌍 The Backrooms Dimension
A fully infinite, procedurally generated yellow corridor dimension. You spawn here directly when creating a new world.
15×15 block rooms connected by 5-block wide doorways
7-block tall ceilings for an even more claustrophobic vibe
Big Rooms (10% chance) — wide open fused spaces
Random corridors linking sectors in unexpected ways
Three types of fluorescent lights: working, flickering, and broken
Natural world structures spawn randomly (see below)

🚪 The Exit Door System (NEW!)
The endgame goal: escape the Backrooms by finding the Exit Door.
Exit Door — a red, "EXIT"-marked door found in rare Exit Rooms
Exit Key — an enchanted-looking key with ~3% drop chance in Wooden Crates
Custom choice GUI — pick your destination (Overworld active, Level 1 coming soon)
Mysterious white fade effect during teleportation
Exit Rooms spawn at 1 in 5000 chunks — true legendary structures

🏗️ Natural World Structures (NEW!)
The Backrooms now contain pre-built structures scattered across the dimension:
🌳 Tree Room (3% of chunks) — mysterious patch of grass with a single tree, contains wooden crates
💼 Office Room (2% of chunks) — abandoned office setup with desks and lootable drawers
🚪 Exit Room (1 in 5000 chunks) — the legendary chamber containing the Exit Door
All containers in structures auto-fill with appropriate loot tables

🔋 Energy System (NEW!)
The hunger bar is replaced by Energy, requiring active stamina management:
Custom HUD bar replaces the food bar
Sprint, jump, and attack consume energy
Sprint boost — 60% faster than vanilla sprint
Dynamic FOV — +25% when sprinting, -15% when exhausted
Energy is infinite in Creative and Spectator modes
🩸 Some weapons can inflict Bleeding — slow damage over time

💧 Almond Water (NEW!)
The canonical Backrooms drink — finally added!
Drinkable item that grants the Energized effect
30 seconds duration · 3x energy regeneration
Returns an empty glass bottle when consumed

🎨 Wall Marking System (NEW!)
Navigate the labyrinth by leaving marks on the walls:
🎨 Spray Can — paints navigation marks on walls
3 symbols to choose from: Arrow Right, Arrow Left, Danger
Sneak + scroll to cycle through symbols
50 uses before breaking
🧽 Sponge — right-click any wall mark to erase it
Wall marks automatically break if their support wall is destroyed

🗡️ Combat Items (NEW!)
The Backrooms are slowly becoming more dangerous:
🪛 Screwdriver — light melee weapon (6 HP damage, fast attack speed)
🗝️ Cutter (BackroomsKey) — also a weapon now, applies Bleeding for 5s

🔦 Flashlight with Battery System
A 3D-modeled flashlight that emits real directional light:
10 minutes of light per battery
Bottom-right HUD overlay showing battery level
Right-click with a battery in your off-hand to recharge
Flickers and dims when battery drops below 10%
Toggleable ON/OFF — manage your power wisely

📱 Phone with Live Exploration Map
A custom handheld device with a glitchy cyberpunk GUI:
Real-time map of every corridor you walk through
30-block exploration radius with persistent saved data
Live coordinates and direction display
Distinguishes between walls and floors based on actual world geometry

💚 Glowstick (Disposable Light)
A single-use crackable light source:
3 minutes of light per glowstick
Emits light when held in hand OR thrown on the ground
Perfect for marking your path through dark hallways

💻 Interactive Computer Terminal
A working in-game pixel-art computer with retro GUI:
Insert a Floppy Disk to boot NEXUS-OS v3.14
9 fully working commands: help, ls, cd, cat, whoami, clear, exit, and a secret command...
Virtual filesystem with 11+ files across nested directories
Read the classified Async Research Institute archives:
- The LPMDS machine logs
- The 1989 Threshold breach incident report
- Personnel records and missing persons reports
- Null Zone analysis and Lifeform sightings
One hidden encrypted file with a passphrase puzzle to solve

🧱 Custom Blocks & Items
🟨 Yellow Wallpaper (breakable only with the Cutter)
🟫 Damp Carpet and ⬜ Ceiling Tile
💡 Fluorescent Light (real light source)
📦 Wooden Crate & Cardboard Box (storage with loot tables)
🗄️ Drawer (18-slot storage)
🪑 Table
🚪 Exit Door (NEW — endgame block)
🗝️ Cutter, 🗝️ Exit Key (NEW)
🔋 Battery, 📼 VHS Tape, 💾 Floppy Disk
🎨 Spray Can with 3 symbols (NEW)
🧽 Sponge (NEW — for erasing wall marks)
💧 Almond Water (NEW)
🪛 Screwdriver (NEW)

🛠️ Commands
/backrooms — Teleport to/from the Backrooms dimension (use this to access the Overworld!)
/backrooms tp — Explicit teleport command
/backrooms fillcrate <wooden|cardboard> — Fill a crate with its loot table
/backrooms reset — Teleport to a fresh, ungenerated area
/backrooms spawntree — Force-place a Tree Room at your location (NEW)
/backrooms spawnoffice — Force-place an Office Room at your location (NEW)
/backrooms spawnexit — Force-place an Exit Room at your location (NEW)

📜 Lore — The Async Research Institute
The mod is built around an original fictional universe inspired by Kane Pixels:

1982. Lawrence Altman founds Async Research Institute in San José, California. Originally building MRI machines, the company secretly develops Project KV31 — a method to access parallel dimensions for storage and overpopulation solutions.

October 17, 1989. During Test #006, Async successfully opens a Threshold to The Complex (the Backrooms). The breach causes an earthquake, kills 63 employees, and leaves 14 missing. The Threshold cannot be closed. Disappearances worldwide rise by 4,700%.

You found their abandoned terminal. The archives are still there.

Explore the computer to uncover the full story.

📥 Installation
Install Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 (build 47.3.0 or higher) from the official Forge website
Drop Stuck_backrooms-0.1.1-alpha.jar into your .minecraft/mods/ folder
Launch Minecraft with the Forge profile
Create a new world — you'll spawn directly in the Backrooms!
Recommended: Play in Creative mode during alpha to access all items

⚠️ This mod must be installed on both client and server for multiplayer use.

🐛 Known Issues (Alpha)
VHS Tape content is currently a placeholder (TV test pattern only)
The computer terminal GUI shows only the hotbar
Level 1 dimension not yet available (Exit Door menu shows it as locked)
No mobs/entities yet — the Backrooms remain eerily empty
As this is my first mod, there may be other issues I haven't discovered yet — please report them!

🔜 Coming in Future Releases
👹 First hostile entity (The Smiler)
🌐 Level 1 dimension (parking garage liminal space) — accessible through the Exit Door
🔊 Ambient sounds (humming neons, distant footsteps, child laughter)
📼 VHS Tape video playback (frame-by-frame animations)
🏗️ More structures (Pool Rooms, Hazmat Locker, Lonely Chair)
🍞 Food sources inside the Backrooms (canned food, vending machines)
🎨 More VHS and Floppy variants with unique content

📜 Credits
Author: imortalfox (first-time modder learning the ropes!)
Lore inspired by: Kane Pixels' Backrooms YouTube series
Universe: Async Research Institute (fictional setting from Kane Pixels)
Additional inspiration: Backrooms community wiki

This is a fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Kane Pixels.

🎮 Compatible With
Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge 47.3.0+
Standalone — no dependencies beyond Forge

Don't look at the lights too long.
Don't run in straight lines.
And whatever you do — never, ever stop walking.
